summary: The blueprint covers the major healthy human pancreas compartments but needs targeted cleanup of developmental/off-scope axes, redundant endothelial structure, and several broad or conflated marker modules.

issues.description: Dedicated endocrine precursor and multipotent pancreatic epithelial progenitor programs are developmentally oriented and are not expected to shape a baseline healthy pancreas embedding when no developmental age or notes are specified.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove these two developmental axes and their now-orphan modules, or replace them with mature pancreas-relevant state axes only if biologically justified for healthy baseline data.

issues.description: The vascular_endothelial and pan_endothelial_identity axes are near-duplicate plain endothelial dimensions, while pan_endothelial is also used as a lymphatic gate despite being mostly blood-endothelial markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep one plain endothelial identity axis, delete or repurpose the redundant plain axis, and retune lymphatic detection as a direct endothelial/lymphatic contrast or with a broader endothelial gate.

issues.description: The stellate/remodeling module heavily overlaps mural and smooth-muscle biology, which may blur pancreatic stellate/fibroblast identity, activated myofibroblast-like state, pericytes, and vascular smooth muscle.
issues.suggested_fix: Retune the stellate/fibroblast module toward ECM/fibroblast or quiescent pancreatic stellate markers, reserve canonical mural genes for pericyte/smooth muscle, and add an activated myofibroblast state only if expected in the baseline data.

issues.description: The leukocyte gate mixes pan-leukocyte markers with myeloid/APC-heavy genes, which can bias gated immune subtype axes away from T, NK, B, plasma, and mast cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the gate more pan-leukocyte using broad immune markers and leave HLA/TYROBP/LST1 biology to myeloid or antigen-presenting modules.

issues.description: Endocrine subtype coverage is present, but some rare-subtype modules rely heavily on shared endocrine transcription factors and processing genes, and DLK1 in the beta-cell module is more fetal/immature than canonical mature beta identity.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the endocrine subtype axes, but tighten markers around subtype-specific hormone and mature identity genes and remove fetal or immaturity-skewing markers unless an immaturity axis is intentionally added.

out_of_scope: The blueprint does not need a disease, fibrosis, inflammation, or development gating tree because the scenario notes and condition do not request one.
Rare circulating granulocytes/neutrophils are not essential for a healthy resident pancreas embedding unless the downstream dataset is known to contain many blood contaminants.
